name: Sabi Omakase Oslo

menus.name: Seasonal Omakase Menu
menus.note: About 20 courses of mostly fish and seafood. Sake pairing or wine and sake pairing NOK 1,850; wine pairing NOK 2,650 (with Krug Grande Cuvée); non-alcoholic pairing NOK 950. No gluten-free, vegetarian, vegan or non-seafood versions.

bookingOpens: Online through Gastroplanner. New tables are released on the 1st of each month at 12pm Oslo time for the following three months. Seatings: Wednesday and Thursday at 7pm; Friday and Saturday at 5pm and 8pm.
cancellation: Cancel, change the date or reduce the number of guests at least 48 hours ahead for up to 4 guests, or 5 days ahead for 5 or more; otherwise a fee of NOK 2,500 per guest is charged. Arriving more than 30 minutes late counts as a no-show.
dressCode: Smart casual. No shorts, tank tops or sandals; guests are asked to avoid strong perfume.
children: No children under 12, nor children who can't eat the set menu.
duration: About two and a half to three and a half hours; all guests start together at the seating time.
